strings: Abubuwan Da Ya Shafa
Yadda abubuwan haɗin gwiwa ke juya LP ƙimar matsayi zuwa ƙarfin aro a cikin Maganar Aro.
Dubawa
Yadda Ake Aiki
Darajar Ƙarabawa
Bayanan kula
Nawa ne matsayi na LP yana ƙidaya zuwa ƙarfin aro bayan rangwamen haɗari.

Abubuwan jingina suna bayyana wane kaso na ƙimar da za a iya dawowa daga matsayi LP zai iya tallafawa bashi. Avana baya amfani da babban alamar LP kaɗai. Borrow Spoke na farko yana sake gina da rage darajar matsayi, sannan ya yi amfani da abin jinginar kasuwa don tantance ƙarfin aro.
Hanyar magana tana karɓar kawai tafkunan da aka amince da su. Matsayi da ba a jera su ba ba su taɓa kai daraja ba.
Matsayin an sake ginawa, an sanya farashi ga kadarorin da ke ƙasa, kuma sakamakon an rage shi zuwa darajar jinginar da za a iya samu.
Ana amfani da abubuwan jinginar da yanayin kasuwa. Rahotannin reshe suna tattara ikon aro zuwa Hub don aiwatarwa.

An ƙididdige ƙimar da za a iya ara kowane matsayi ne, ba a matsayin adadi ɗaya ga duk asusun ba. Matsayi biyu a cikin tafkuna daban-daban na iya samar da ƙimar dawowa daban-daban kuma su bayyana abubuwa daban-daban na jingina ko da sun yi kama.
Matsayin da aka tallafawa LP yana ba da damar aron kudi ne kawai bayan mai magana ya amince da shi, ya kiyasta shi cikin hankali, kuma ya yi amfani da abin da kasuwa ke ɗauka a matsayin jingina.
• Mahimman abubuwan haɗin kai suna rayuwa a cikin kowane daidaitawar tafkin da aka goyan baya.
• Iyalai LP daban-daban na iya samun abubuwa daban-daban, iyakokin warware abubuwa, da ƙarin ladan.
• Karanta wannan tare da Health Factor da Liquidation Framework lokacin gina kayan aikin sa ido.

asusun har yanzu yana wucewa gwaje-gwaje, amma ajiyar kudi kadan ne. Yi la'akari da biya, ƙara jinginar, ko rage haɗari.
Mai iya cirewa ko mayar da ruwa
lafiya ta wuce iyakar gurguntar da kuɗi. Hanyar dawo da lafiya za ta iya fara.

Da zarar lafiya ta ketare iyakar sayar da kaya, masu sayar da kaya na iya juyar da hanyar jinginar da ake bukata don dawo da ikon biyan bashi bisa ka'idojin sayar da kaya na kasuwa.

strings: Incentives Programs
Yadda zaɓaɓɓun kamfen ɗin lada ke alaƙa da Avana ba tare da canza abubuwan asali na ba da rancen ba.
Dubawa
Nau'ikan Shirye-shirye
Ka'idojin Rarrabawa
Ikirari & Sasanci
Matsayi Na Yanzu
Kamfen ɗin lada na zaɓi waɗanda ke zaune a saman Avana ba tare da canza abubuwan asali na ba da rancen ba.

Tushen ƙarfafawa abu ne na waje, ba wani ɓangare na babban tsarin bashi ba. An fayyace tsarin ta hanyar ƙima LP, kulawar haɗari ta Borrow Spoke, ruwa na Hub, da tsiratarwa. Kamfen na iya ƙarfafa shiga, amma ba su canza waɗannan dabarun ba.
Kamfen ɗin suna aiki ne kuma suna da iyaka na lokaci. Wannan ba yana nufin cewa wani shirin lada na musamman yana aiki a kowane tura ba.
Kamfen na fuskantar mai bayarwa wanda ke zurfafa jari a cikin Lend Spoke ko haɗin Layer na ruwa
Kamfen din da suka shafi masu aro waɗanda ke ƙarfafa aro mai lafiya da goyon bayan LP
Kamfen ɗin mai aiki ko na tsarin halittu da ke da alaƙa da gwaji, haɗawa, ko aikin tallafawa haɗari

Lokacin da abubuwan ƙarfafawa suka wanzu, yakamata su zama abin fahimta, abin dubawa, kuma a ware su daga ainihin ma'anar haɗari. Lissafin ladan ƙila ya dogara da aiki, tsawon lokaci, ko ƙa'idodin yaƙin neman zaɓe, amma bai kamata ya canza yadda Avana ke darajar jingina ko yanke shawarar cancantar ruwa ba.

Hanyoyin da'awar, jadawali, da hanyoyin sulhu sun keɓance na yakin neman zabe. Ana iya sarrafa su akan sarkar, ta hanyar keɓantaccen mai kula da lada, ko ta hanyar lissafin kashe-kashe da ma'aikacin kamfen ya buga.
Masu haɗa tsarin ya kamata su tabbatar da hanyar da'awar da ke aiki da ƙa'idodin cancanta don aikin da suke niyya.

Dubi abubuwan ƙarfafawa a matsayin na musamman ga kowace shiri da yanayi. Idan wani kamfen yana gudana, ya kamata a bayyana cikakkun bayanansa daban tare da kwanan wata, ƙa'idoji, da sharuddan rarrabawa.

meta.description: Yadda masu bayar da rance ke samar da kadarori ta hanyar Lend Spoke don kudi LP-cikakken jinginar.

strings: Aron Magana
Yadda masu bayar da rance ke samar da kadarori ta hanyar Lend Spoke don kudi LP-cikakken jinginar.
Dubawa
Babban Ƙofar Shiga
Daidaita Haɗarin Haɗari
Kula da Hadari Mai Gudana
Babban abin samarwa
Adadin masu ba da bashi ETH, BTC, stablecoins, da sauran kadarori masu goyan baya ta hanyar Lend Spoke.
Hanya ta ta through Hub
Babban birni yana motsawa cikin matakin ajiyar Hub, inda wani tafki zai iya tallafawa kasuwannin aron da yawa na LP-jarin jingina.
Asusun Ara Magana
Samo lamuni daga Spokes yana amfani da ruwan jari na Hub yayin da ake kiyaye ƙimar LP da ka'idojin fitar da dukiya a kowane kasuwa.
Haɗin tafkin da sauya ma'aunin kayan ajiya
Yawan kasuwanci da samar da kuɗin hukumar da aka aiwatar
Bambancin farashi tsakanin kadarorin da aka haɗa
Sauye-sauyen yanayin tashin hankali da daidaiton tsari
Zurfin ruwa da ake da shi yayin rushewar damuwa
Yadda masu ba da lamuni ke ba da kadarorin da ke ba da rancen LP jingina.

Masu bayar da bashi suna samar da kadarori kamar ETH, BTC, GHO, USDC, USDT, ko sauran alamu da aka goyi baya cikin bangaren masu bayar da bashi na tsarin. Wannan babban jari yana bi ta Hub don tallafawa aron a kasuwannin LP-kadarori.

Masu bayar da bashi ba sa sarrafa kewayon LP, asarar wucin gadi, ko ayyukan jinginar AMM na musamman. Hanyoyin Barnatar da Bashi suna kula da tsarin bita da na sayarwa na LP, yayin da babban jarin mai bayar da bashi ke ba da ƙarfin ga matakin bashi.

Ajiyar mai bayar da bashi na zuwa ta Lend Spoke farko, sannan ya shiga cikin rukunin ajiya na Hub da ake rabawa. Ba lallai bane a raba babban kudi bisa kowanne LP kasuwa, koda yake dokokin aro suna ci gaba da kasancewa daban a gefen spoke.
A farkon zagayowar rayuwa, ana iya ƙara yawan kuɗin Hub ta layukan kiredit Aave v4. A tsawon lokaci, adibas na Lend Spoke na iya zama babban kaso na babban rance na asali.

Ribar mai kaya tana fitowa daga masu aron kudi da suke biyan ruwa don samun likiditi wanda aka tallafa da LP jingina. Avana tana haɗa ratar tushe ta Hub da aka raba tare da karin haɗarin matakin reshe da aka danganta da kasuwannin LP da ake ba da kuɗi.

Rates move with market conditions, available liquidity, utilization, and the risk profile of underlying borrower markets. Actual returns depend on live configuration, not a fixed assumption from documentation.

LP jinginar jari yana canzawa tare da haɗin gwiwar tafkin, girma, bambanci, rashin tabbas, da zurfin sakin jari. Iyakokin haɗari na iya amsawa ga waɗannan sigina maimakon dogaro kawai da saitunan tsaye.

Aron Magana
Kasuwar haɗin LP da ta keɓe inda masu amfani ke ajiye matsayi, aro kadarori, da sarrafa lafiyar bashi.

Tsakiyar Lamuni Wata kasuwa ce ta LP-kolateral wacce aka ware. Yana yanke shawarar waɗanne tafkuna ake tallafawa, yadda kowace matsayi ta LP ake ƙididdige ta, wane abubuwan kolateral suka dace, waɗanne dukiyoyi za a iya aro, da yadda lalacewa take aiki a wannan kasuwa.

Ana raba Spokes na Lamuni saboda matsayi LP ba duka suna aiki iri ɗaya ba. Stablecoin LP, correlated ETH-staked ETH LP, da volatile governance-token LP suna buƙatar saitin haɗari daban, iyakoki daban, kuma wani lokaci hanyoyin lalata daban.
Ruwan Hayar

Daga bangaren mai amfani, wanda yayi magana yana kula da cikakken tsarin rayuwar asusu: ajiya LP lamuni, duba iya rance, aro, biya, da biyan kuɗi idan an yarda. Keɓancewar zance yana tsayawa ko da a lokacin da tsarin LP na asali ya bambanta a cikin DEXs.
Mataki 1: Deposit LP jingina
Mai amfani yana ajiye matsayi na LP da aka amince da shi. Ruwa yana kasancewa a cikin tafki, amma sashen yana rubuta shi a matsayin jingina kuma yana fara bibiyar ƙima da lafiya.
Mataki na 2: Ana lissafin ƙarfin
Mai magana yana sake gina matsayi, farashi mai fa'ida, yana amfani da abubuwan haɗin gwiwa, kuma yana nuna sakamakon lamuni.
Mataki na 3: Aron kadarorin
The user draws assets from Hub liquidity up to their capacity. Debt and health update in the spoke after the borrow confirms.
Mataki na 4: Ƙara ƙarin garanti
Ƙarin matsayin da aka amince da su LP za a iya ajiye su daga baya. Ana kimanta kowanne matsayi a kansa kafin a haɗa shi da jimillar ƙarfi.
Borrowers
Masu amfani suna hulɗa tare da Maganar Borrow don saka hannun jari, aro, biya, da sarrafa lamunin su.
Maganar aro (Avana)
Values LP positions, enforces health checks, and coordinates liquidation when collateral no longer supports the debt.
Aave v4 Tushen
Shared liquidity and accounting layer. Borrow Spokes draw from Hub reserves after spoke-side checks pass.
Bayanin jingina yana shiga reshe
— an rubuta kuma a bi matsayin LP don ƙididdiga da lafiya.
Borrow yana zana kudin ruwa na Hub
- da zarar iya aiki ya wuce, mai magana yana buƙatar kadarori daga Hub.
Bashi yana karuwa a matsayin hannun jari
— riba tana tarawa ta hanyar samfurin ƙimar da aka saita yayin da reshe yake kiyaye yanayin asusun a daidaito.
Rarrabuwa idan an buƙata
— asusun da basu da lafiya suna bi ta hanyar hanyar likwidasyon don dawo da iya biyan bashi.

an samu bayanai daga Hub lokacin da mai amfani ya buɗe ko ya ƙara bashi

magana yana mayar da bashi zuwa Hub lokacin da mai amfani ya biya

Cibiyar na iya kiran
sarrafa ruwa
Bangaren

Yana bibiyar matsayi LP, jimillar ƙimar jinginar, da bashi ga kowane iyali AMM. Yana bayyana
samiJimillarMaiAmfani(user)

Yana gudanar da tara tarar rashin biya, sassauta hankali, da karshe na lalatawa ga tsarin LP waɗanda ke buƙatar kulawa ta musamman.

The Borrow Spoke ba ya riƙe ajiyar mai bayar da bashi. Hub yana ba da haɗin ƙarfafa kuɗi, lissafin ajiyar, da bangaren da ke da alaƙa da cin bashi a cikin takardar kudade yayin da Spoke ke kula da haɗarin da ya shafi LP.
Samar da babban birni
Kayayyaki irin su USDC, DAI, da ETH suna shiga ta hanyar Lend Spoke da Hub. The Borrow Spoke ya yanke shawarar nawa ne na wannan kuɗin da asusun tallafi na LP zai iya shiga.
Layin bashi
Kowane Borrow Spoke yana da layin bashi wanda ke iyakance yawan ruwa na Hub da zai iya jawo, yana kiyaye LP bincike mai zaman kansa yayin raba ingancin jari.
Abubuwan kiwon lafiya masu zaman kansu
Amsar jinginar a cikin batutuwan bashi da yawa ana tantance ta daban. Rashin daidaito a kasuwa ɗaya ba ya rufe ƙaranci a wata ta atomatik.

strings: Kudin Dandali

Fuskar Mai amfani vs Tsarin sadarwa

Kudin matakin fuska a kan Avana gaba, daban daga tattalin arzikin aro na ka’idar.
Avana na iya cajin kudaden shafin gaba ko na sabis a kan hanyoyin hukuma. Wadannan cajin suna daban da ka'idojin jinginar, mashigin bayanai, da magance rashin biyan bashi na tsarin.
Kudin kuɗi, keɓancewa, da matsayin ƙaddamarwa su ne saitunan aiki. Tabbatar da su a cikin tsarin kai tsaye ko kayan sakin kafin dogara da su.

Kwangiloli masu mahimmanci suna gudanar da LP shiga, ƙarfin aro, da ruwa. Kudaden mu'amala, idan an kunna, zauna a saman azaman manufofin kasuwanci na gaba maimakon azaman canji ga rance ko injin haɗari.
Ƙididdiga na tattalin arziƙin ƙa'ida yana ƙayyade yawan bashin, jiyya na jingina, da sakamakon ruwa
Kudin haɗin gwiwa yana da alaƙa da wani takamaiman fuskar gaba ko hanyar sabis

Dole ne a nuna kowace ƙimar ƙirar fuska a sarari kafin sanya hannu domin masu amfani su iya bambance ta da kuɗin iskar gas, kuɗin musayar, da bashi ko tasirin rushewar matakin tsarin.

Idan ana tattara kudaden shiga na kewayawa, yawanci suna ba da tallafi ga ayyukan samfur iri kamar gina ababen more rayuwa, sa ido, ayyukan tsaro, da tallafi. Gwamnati na iya tabbatar da waɗannan manufofi ko sake duba su a kan lokaci.

Karɓi kuɗin ciniki daga matsayinka na LP yayin da yake aiki a matsayin jinginar.
Avana yana bin manyan kudaden ruwa da kudaden da aka tara daban. Wannan yana nufin zaku iya neman kuɗin shiga daga LP ba tare da rufe matsayin da ke goyan bayan lamunin ku ba.

Kira kudade har yanzu suna shafar ƙimar jinginar ku, don haka Avana yana gudanar da binciken lafiya kafin da bayan kiran. Idan kiran kudade zai sa asusunka ya faɗi ƙasa da iyakar jinginar da ake buƙata, ana toshe kiran har sai ka biya bashi ko ka ƙara ƙarin jinginar.
A cikin Avana keɓaɓɓen fuska, buɗe aikin karɓar-kuɗaɗen don matsayinka da ka ajiye. Avana yana jagorantar karɓar ta hanyar hanyar DEX na musamman don irin LP.

Don DEXs mai daɗaɗɗen ruwa, yawanci kira ne irin na tattarawa wanda ke jan kuɗin da aka tara yayin barin babba a cikin tafkin. Don alamomin LP masu ƙarfi, Avana tana amfani da hanyar da'awar kuɗin asali na DEX lokacin da akwai.
Bayan an karɓi kudade, Avana yana daidaita sabon halin matsayin baya cikin Borrow Spoke don lafiyar da ikon aron su nuna sabon ma'auni.

Binciken riba ya kamata a yi lissafin zamewa, zurfin hanya, farashin lamuni, da haɗarin kisa. Manya ko sabon iska na iya fa'ida daga hanyoyin aiwatarwa masu zaman kansu don rage faɗuwar MEV.

Yadda shigarwar likwidasiyo, karɓar dakin ajiya, da biyan LP suke rarrabuwa tsakanin Aave da Avana.

Aave ita ce tsarin da ke yanke shawara lokacin da za a iya yin sayar da wani matsayi, amma ba ta san yadda za a warware ainihin LP ba. Avana yana amfani da Aave don lissafin bashi, dubawa lafiyar, da wurin shiga sayarwa, sannan ya ɗauki nauyi don warware ainihin matsayin da ke bayan jinginar akwati.

Mahimmin ƙaƙƙarfan ƙira shine cewa ra'ayoyi biyu na haɗin gwiwa dole ne su kasance cikin layi ɗaya. Aave yana ganin ma'auni na ERC-20 vault vault, yayin da Avana yana bin matsayin LP wanda a zahiri ke goyan bayan wannan ma'auni. Liquidation ya kasance mai sauti ne kawai idan kwace wakilcin vault koyaushe yana kaiwa ga daidai hanyar sulhu LP.

Aave tsarin
Yana bin bashi, ma'aunin lamuni, yanayin lafiya, da wurin shigar ruwa wanda ke ba da izinin kama.
Avana Adaftar Layer
Yana karɓar jinginar kanti da aka kwace, yana ƙone token ɗin kanti da ya dace, kuma yana haɗa abin da ya faru na sallama zuwa matsayin LP wanda ya goyi bayan sa a zahiri.
Avana Layer Layer
Yana gano ainihin matsayin LP, yana gudanar da hanyar fitarwa ko sayarwa da ta dace, yana biya bashi, yana biyan sakon mai tsarkakewa, kuma yana tura duk wani karin kudi bisa ga dokar kasuwa.

Babban ƙa'ida mai sauƙi ne amma mai tsauri: Aave yana kawar da jinginar ajiyar ERC-20, kuma Avana yana biya matsayin LP da ke bayan wannan jinginar ajiyar. Duk sauran abubuwan da ke cikin tsari suna kasancewa ne don kiyaye waɗannan matakai biyu daidaito.
Dole ne alamun ajiyar kuɗi su dace da ainihin ƙima
Adadin vault mai ruwa ya zama dole koyaushe yayi daidai da ƙimar LP na gaske, ba ma'auni na roba wanda ba za a iya dawo da shi ba.
Ba za a iya barin jinginar da ke tallafawa ba
Da zarar an daidaita matsayin LP, dole ne a ƙone alamar vault ɗin da ta dace don kada wakilcin ya wuce kadarar da aka yi nufin waƙa.
Active vault token supply cannot exist without active LP collateral behind it.
Riba tana bin ƙa'idar kasuwa
Ana fara fara biyan bashi, sannan ladan mai ruwa, sannan farashin sasantawa, sannan duk wani darajar da ta rage ta bi ka'idar rarar kasuwa.

Matsayin da aka tallafa wa LP ba duka suke yin aiki iri ɗaya ba yayin warwarewa. Ana iya fansa ko canja wurin alamar LP da za a iya musanya sau da yawa gwargwadon kashi, yayin da Uniswap v3 NFT guda ɗaya matsayi ne guda ɗaya wanda kewayon sa, tarin kuɗin sa, da hanyar warwarewa suke da mahimmanci a matakin matsayi.
Shi ya sa matakin sulhu yake bukatar sanin dangin jinginar, madaidaitan matsayin tallafi, da hanyar nufin fitarwa kafin ya share damar daidaita ajiyar ma’ajin.
Hanyar biyan bashin tana dogara ne akan irin LP jinginar da ke bayan tambarin matattara.
Kayan jingina mai musanya LP
Matsala na iya zama daidai da bashin da dole ne a rufe, maimakon tilasta duk ma'auni LP ta hanyar ruwa.
• Avana na iya fansa ko canja wuri kawai adadin da ake bukata don kammala sayarwa idan tsarin kasuwa yana goyon bayan samun kaso na dawo da kudade.
Matsayin da ya rage na iya zama mai aiki idan har yanzu asusun ya gamsar da binciken lafiyar da ake buƙata bayan haka.
• Cikakken matsayi yana motsawa zuwa sasantawa lokacin da aka zaba shi don ruwa saboda NFT kanta ita ce sashin lamuni da ake warwarewa.
• Ana ƙonewa da alamomin ma'ajiyar da suka dace bayan Aave ya kwace gurbin ajiyar kuma Avana ya maido wannan kwacen zuwa matsayin NFT.
• Avana zai iya sassauta, siyarwa, yin sayarwa ta gasa, ko canja matsayin LP na gaske bisa ga dokokin kasuwa na wannan dangin jinginar.
• Ragowar ba ya zuwa hannun mai warware batun kai tsaye sai dai idan ƙa'idar kasuwa ta bayyana hakan a fili.
ACTIVE
Matsayin har yanzu yana kara ƙimar jingina, kuma alamomin ƙarƙashin shingen da ba a biya ba suna nan gaba ɗaya suna da goyon baya daga wannan matsayin na rayuwa LP.
Rage Harsashi
Zaɓaɓɓen abin lamunin da mai karɓar bashi ba zai iya cirewa kuma yana tafiya ta hanyar sasantawa.
SETTLED
Matsayin LP an warware shi, kuma dole ne a daina samun alamomin ajiya da suka dace ba su wanzu ba.

Ana amfani da ƙimar daidaitawa a ƙayyadadden tsari. Da farko yana rufe bashi, sannan ladan mai biya, sannan farashin sasantawa. Duk wani darajar da aka bari bayan waɗancan wajibai ragi ne, kuma wannan rarar tana bin ka'idar kasuwa don sasantawa.

Idan darajar sulhu ba ta isa ba don rufe bashi da lada, kasuwa na bukatar hanya ta bayyana ta bashin da ba a biya ba. Takardun kashe-haja ya kamata su bayyana wannan gibi a matsayin gaskiyar da za a magance, ba a matsayin wani abu da zai ɓace kai tsaye ba.

Ana iya yin cire bashi ba tare da izini ba lokacin da matsayi ya wuce iyakar cire bashi. Duk wani mai cire bashi mai cancanta na iya biya adadin bashin da aka yarda da shi kuma ya tayar da hanyar daidaitawa. LP jinginar abu ya fi wuya a cire fiye da jinginar alamar sauki, don haka Avana shima yana la'akari da rufe cire bashi na musamman.
Masu wargaza dole su bi diddigin irin wannan yanayin haɗari da yanayin jingina da tsarin yake amfani da shi.
Kisa dole ne ya kasance atomiki daga biyan bashi ta hanyar sasantawa.
Ya kamata a tsara fahimtar kuɗi, zurfin hanya, da ƙimar ragowar kafin a zaɓi kawai don sauri.
Rufe wani ɓangare da cikakken rufe suna da batutuwa daban-daban kuma bai kamata su raba irin waɗannan shawarwarin hanyar ba.

Spoke ɗin yana sake gina matsayin daga bayanan tafkin sa, yana tantance farashin fuskantar asusun ta hanyar ginin oracle, sannan yana rage wannan ƙimar ta hanyar abubuwan jinginar jari da kuma ƙa'idodin kasuwa na musamman.

Idan sakamakon da aka samu ya wadatar, lamunin yana zana ne daga yawan ruwa na Hub yayin da binciken lafiya, lissafin lamuni, da kuma halin rashin ruwa ke kasancewa musamman ga wannan magana.

An gina tsarin don LP matsayi waɗanda ya kamata su ci gaba da yin LP aiki. Mai aro ba lallai ne ya cire kuɗi daga AMM ba kawai don samun kuɗi a kansa.

LP jinginar ba a sarrafa shi kamar daidaitaccen ma'aunin token ba. Kowace kasuwa da aka tallafa ta fayyace yadda ake dawo da ƙima, abin da ake sayarwa ko sokewa, da yadda ake rufe bashi idan asusun ya zama ba lafiya.

Ya yarda da goyon bayan LP haɗin gwiwa, yana mai da shi ƙarfin rancen matakin magana, kuma ya mallaki ka'idojin kiwon lafiya da na ruwa na wannan kasuwa.
Yana rike da littafin ma'auni na rance na haɗin gwiwa: lissafin ajiya, dabarun ƙimar ruwa, da ruwa da rassan masu karɓar bashi ke jan daga gare shi.

Yana shigar da kadarorin masu ba da bashi a cikin tsarin kuma yana tura su zuwa Hub don haka LP rubutaccen rubutun zai iya zama daban da babban kan jirgin.

LP ɗinku na iya ci gaba da samun kuɗaɗen kuɗi a cikin tafki yayin da yake tallafawa bashi. Avana yana sanya hakan ya yiwu a Aave v4: igiyoyi suna sarrafa haɗarin musamman na LP, Hub yana ba da ƙarfin ruwa na bashi na haɗin gwiwa.

Bincika Maganar Borrow

Avana ƙa'idar lamuni ce da aka gina don LP jingina. Yana ba masu amfani damar saka tallafin AMM matsayi, kiyaye waɗancan wuraren aiki a cikin tafkin da ke ƙasa, da aro a kansu ta hanyar kayan aikin Aave v4.

Masu samar da ruwa sau da yawa suna buƙatar cire ruwa kafin su iya aro da jari na su. Wannan yana nufin barin tafkin, sallamar damar samun kuɗi, da kuma katse matsayin kasuwa da suka riga suka ginawa.

Avana yana magance wannan ta hanyar samar da matsayi na LP da za'a iya amfani da su azaman abin dogaro. LP yana zama mai rai, Avana yana waƙa da ƙimar matsayi, kuma Aave v4 yana sarrafa lissafin gefen aro ta hanyar alamar lamuni ta ciki.
Gudanarwar da mai amfani ke gani gajere ce, amma kowace mataki tana ɓoye aikin tantance haɗarin LP na musamman. Shafukan daga baya suna bayyana yadda kowane mataki yake aiki.
LP matsayi sun riga sun zauna a cikin babban aikin kudi. Ba tare da wani matakin bayar da rance ba, samun kuɗi daga baya yawanci yana nufin rage ko rufe matsayin tafkin farko.

Avana yana amfani da Aave v4 saboda LP jinginar abu yana buƙatar raba ruwa da tunanin haɗarin musamman a lokaci guda. Hub yana sarrafa ƙaƙƙarfan layin kuɗi yayin da reshe ke kula da aikin musamman na LP: rajistar jinginar abu a cikin tafki, kimanta matsayi, aiwatar da haɗarin, da aiwatar da safarar kuɗi.

Masu gine-gine ya kamata su yi tunanin tsarin a cikin rabin biyu. Hub shine takardar kididdigar gama gari da injin bashi, yayin da Rassa na Ara wucewa suke yanke shawara game da abin da kowace kasuwa LP zata iya tallafawa cikin aminci da yadda dole ne a warware wannan kasuwa idan ta gaza. Rassa na Bashi yana ciyar da babban jari cikin Hub domin masu samarwa ba sa buƙatar tunani game da ƙa'idodin LP kawai don samar da ruwa.

Yadda Avana ke ba da shawara, nazari, da aiwatar da canje-canjen haɗari a fadin Hub da LP Rassa na Kayayyaki.

Tsarin Kasada na Avana yana fayyace yadda ake gabatar da canje-canje na sigogi, dubawa, da aiwatarwa a ko'ina cikin Cibiyar da LP Rassa na Kayan Haɗi. Yana rufe sarrafawa da ake amfani da su lokacin da tsarin ke daidaita iyakokin samarwa da aron kudi, saitunan LT/LTV, shigarwar ribar kudi, matsayin kasuwa, da sauran sigogi da ke dogara ga farashi, amfani, zurfin tafkin, taruwa, rashin tabbas, halayen makulli, na'urorin dakatarwa, lafiyar matsayi, da matsayin da ya shafi makamantan su.

LP lamuni ba aji ɗaya ba ne. Stable LPs, kadara mai alaƙa LPs, wuraren waha mai nauyi, yawan ruwa mai yawa, da sauran ƙirar AMM kowanne na iya samun takamaiman hanyar ƙimar magana, hanyar ruwa, da yanayin gazawa. Tsarin yana wanzuwa don haka waɗannan bambance-bambancen suna nunawa a cikin tsarin sabuntawa maimakon a ɓoye a bayan saitin haɗari guda ɗaya.

Matsayi guda uku sun bambanta a cikin wannan tsari: Avana Mai Haɗa Haɗari, Avana Mai gadin Hatsari, da Avana Mai Kare Hatsari. Jam'iyyar da ke ba da shawarar sauyi na yau da kullun ba ita ce jam'iyyar da ke bincikar ta da kanta ba, kuma rawar da za ta iya aiwatarwa a lokacin gaggawa ta kasance da gangan kunkuntar hanyar yau da kullun.
Dokar aiki:

Canje-canje na yau da kullum suna bin wata hanya ta dindindin don haka ka’ida za ta iya bambance kulawa ta al’ada da kuma dakile gaggawa. Tsarin da aka saba shine sanarwar jama’a, gabatarwa, duba iyaka, lokaci a kulle, bita daga Guardian, da aiwatarwa idan ba a soke shawarar ba.
Canje-canje na sigogi ba duka suke ɗauke da irin wannan haɗari ba, don haka tsarin yana rarraba su bisa yawan iko da ya kamata su buƙata da yadda sauri zasu iya motsawa.
Duk sabunta al'ada ya kamata a buga shi kafin gabatarwa a cikin tsari wanda ke ba wa masu haɓakawa, masu amfani, da masu duba damar kwatanta sanarwar da ainihin aikin da aka sanyaya daga baya.

Mai Kariya na Hadari ya kamata ya aikata ne kawai lokacin da yanayin gazawa da aka bayyana ko wanda ake da tabbacin gaske ya sa hanyar lokaci ta al'ada ba ta da aminci.
